name: appointment-recovery-waitlist
description: Missed Appointment Recovery + Waitlist Filler (DEV-1223) — one durable AppointmentSlot actor per appointment slot owns the recovery workflow: call/text the missed patient to reschedule, then work the waitlist in priority order until the first confirmation wins. Retries, reply windows, confirmation lock, and slot expiry survive restarts; double-booking is impossible.
author: Telnyx
